videos.title: B.O.R.(Birth Of Rap)
videos.description: To say I saw this in 2009 would be a lie; I was only nine myself and I certainly was not tapped in at the time. It is pretty wild to think that this came out in 2009 in the first place. Truly a Based God.

videos.title: No One Knows
videos.description: This takes Ame back to mtv and early itunes. Around the time I first Saw this video I was probably around 7? Queens Of The Stone age are Legends with and without Dave Grohls help on the drums.

videos.title: Last Nite
videos.description: This video and simply The Strokes in general have been bleeding nostalgia for me. I was quite young when this album initially came out but Last Nite was a song that was on my Pops' own ipod and I've been listening ever since. Time flies.

videos.title: Helena
videos.description: All I have to say is that I have Black Parade special edition cd that I stole from my pops. Shout out him my emo king.

videos.title: Oldie
videos.description: This marked a truly unique time and era of the 2010's. I was in highschool at the time and these guys we're my biggest inspiration. Odd Futures influence not only in my life but the future of music and street wear is imeasurable and completely encompased my highschool years.
